part.text:
Fixed the localized float alignment bug in `include/fmt/format.h:8519`. Separator count was based on the full significand instead of the integral-part digit count (`exp`), causing width miscalculation when the integer part was zero.

Validated with the reported example plus `xchar-test` (35 passed) and `format-test` (114 passed).
